evidence.title: Canada Settlement Charge Adjustment to Financial Reporting
evidence.summary: BAT has implemented a new non-GAAP measure related to a legal settlement (Approved Plans) concerning Imperial Tobacco Canada Limited, where a charge based on a percentage of ITCAN's adjusted profit from operations will be applied until an aggregate settlement amount is paid. This reflects a regulatory/legal resolution impacting financial reporting and reduces over time per agreed terms.
evidence.quote: This charge will continue until the aggregate settlement amount is paid... for the purposes of 2025 versus 2024 this charge is 100% of the profit after interest and tax from all sources in Canada, excluding New Categories.
